items.html: And indeed, the explanation of this mishna is as follows: there are two Kabin, one good, which is the secret of the three fillings of AV, SAG, MAH mentioned above, which are nineteen, thirty-seven, forty-five, in gematria one hundred and two, and it is from the phase of the face, which she receives at the time of the union face to face. And this is the Kav that the woman wants from it, and from abstinence. For the woman is the fourth Name, which is Ben, which is in Malchut called Challah, as mentioned above, and receives the three fillings mentioned, called the pure Kav.
